t: Childers be and is hereby granted permission, revocable at will of the Board of Supervisors, to maintain and operate an automobile supply station on the southeast corner of Gough and Lombard streets.

Ormand H. Nelson be and is hereby granted permission, revocable at will of the Board of Supervisors, to maintain and operate an automobile supply station on premises at the southwest corner of Thirty-third avenue and Geary street.
